name: roarmind
description: RoarMind: ask your Mac in everyday words; files, emails, screenshots and notes, found by what they say, all on this Mac. The Mad Lions Lab.
author: THEMADLIONS

scripts.helper: mkdir -p helper/bin && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12 -o helper/bin/helper-arm64 helper/main.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos12 -o helper/bin/helper-x64 helper/main.swift && lipo -create -output helper/bin/roarmind-helper helper/bin/helper-arm64 helper/bin/helper-x64 && codesign --force --sign - helper/bin/roarmind-helper
scripts.dist:mac: npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: RoarMind reads your notes in the Notes app to find them for you. Nothing leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: RoarMind reads the folders you choose to find your files for you. Nothing leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: RoarMind reads the folders you choose to find your files for you. Nothing leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: RoarMind reads the folders you choose to find your files for you. Nothing leaves this Mac.
